files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A horizontal strip of dishes that scrolls sideways (a focusable, named region with snap points): small cards
  with a picture, name, weight, price and an add button. Axes: size (sm, lg), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";

  export type DishStripProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    dishes: Dish[];
    empty?: string;
    labels: FoodLabels;
    size?: "sm" | "lg";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import AddIcon from "../components/add-icon.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    dishes,
    empty = "",
    labels,
    size = "sm",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: DishStripProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((dishes?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="star" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <List
      tag="ul"
      class="-mx-4 flex snap-x gap-4 overflow-x-auto px-4 pb-4"
      tabindex={0}
      aria-label={labels.strip}
      data-testid="items"
    >
      {#each dishes as d (d.id)}
        <ListItem
          class={
            (size as string) === "lg" ? "flex w-64 shrink-0 snap-start flex-col gap-2"
            : "flex w-48 shrink-0 snap-start flex-col gap-2"
          }
          data-testid="item"
        >
          <MediaFrame alt={d.name} ratio={(((size as string) === "lg") ? "4/3" : "1/1")} />
          <Group gap="2" align="baseline" justify="between">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {d.name}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {d.weight}
            </Text>
          </Group>
          <Group gap="2" align="center" justify="between">
            <Inline class="text-sm font-bold">
              {fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency)}
            </Inline>
            <AddIcon label={tpl(labels.addOf, d.name)} />
          </Group>
        </ListItem>
      {/each}
    </List>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
